data.name: Jatinder
data.gender_notes: Jatinder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jatinder is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Jat' meaning sun and 'Indra' meaning king or god of rain. Thus, Jatinder can be interpreted as the 'Sun God King' or 'King of the Sun'. The name Jatinder carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Hindi. Parents who choose Jatinder usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jatinder is a powerful name that is believed to bring the blessings of the Sun God, Indra, who is revered for his strength, courage, and wisdom. This name is also said to inspire loyalty, courage, and strength in the bearer.
data.etymology: Jatinder belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jatinder total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Therefore, the name Jatinder holds enormous cultural significance in Indian society as it symbolizes the importance of natural elements for survival and livelihood.
